image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a brown snake coiled on weathered wooden planks. The focus is sharp on the mid-body coils in the foreground, revealing detailed scale texture, while the head and tail are out of focus or outside the frame in the background.

The tail end is not visible in the frame; the body trails off into the blur.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The scale pattern in the sharpest focus area appears slightly repetitive and overly uniform compared to natural biological variance, suggesting potential AI generation smoothing, though it remains physically plausible.

The transition from sharp focus to blur is very rapid. While this mimics macro photography bokeh, the smoothness of the blur lacks the typical chromatic aberration or lens distortion seen in real macro shots, appearing slightly 'digital'.
